# Immutable processional revision-one baseline

Exact pre-change source/test JSON and text goldens are bound by SHA256SUMS.txt.
Do not rewrite historical hashes to bless revision2. Runtime terrain-only JSON
in data/floors/revision1/processional.json retains the true revision1 map.

Raised choir walk crosses the organ chamber east-side gap into the central nave. Its three-cell deck rises2.5→6m over12m, stages a6m landing, then descends6→2.5m over12m. The original north/outer return remains. No over-under geometry is claimed.

All actor, hero, pickup, interaction, door, encounter, scenery, light and spawn
records are unchanged. Shared schema/floor-lookup integration is parent-owned.
Static triangles, native codec/navigation and normal Player capsule fixtures
are separate evidence; none certifies earned resources/seal orders, physical
input, art quality, GPU performance or packaged-release acceptance.
